# Shipwise label fleet - print job export

telemetry/label-print-jobs.jsonl covers the week of 24 August 2026, one record per label print job, one JSON object per line, collected from the fleet. elapsed is the time the print driver measured for the job.

turns.prompt: Shipwise is reviewing throughput of its label printing fleet for the week of 24 August 2026. That week's job export is available.
